Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production game decal texture atlas with a genuinely transparent RGBA background, for overlaying weathering on existing dungeon walls in an isometric fantasy RPG.
Primary request: generate a single 1536x1024 landscape atlas arranged as an exact 3-column by 2-row grid of six 512x512 cells. No visible grid lines or text. Each cell is an isolated irregular weathering decal, with empty transparent space around it. DO NOT include any underlying stone, brick, wall surface, opaque background or cast shadow. Only the dirt/moss/crack itself should be opaque or semitransparent. The existing wall must show through every gap.
Cell layout left to right:
Top left: irregular sparse dark olive and muted moss-green moss patch, fine tiny moss clumps and lichen speckles, broad uneven branching outline and many transparent gaps, about 65 percent cell extent.
Top middle: weathered branching hairline wall fissure, thin charcoal brown fracture with irregular angular branches and a few tiny chipped mineral edges, no stone background, asymmetrical diagonal broken path.
Top right: old dark grey-brown water seep stain, wider irregular damp patch near the upper portion splitting into 6 to 10 uneven long thin descending vertical drip trails and faint diffuse smears, semitransparent at edges and ends, restrained pale mineral residue.
Bottom left: a distinctly different moss colony with several islands of low dark olive moss, scattered flecks and ragged soft organic outline, earthy realistic details, not a solid green disk.
Bottom middle: a different irregular branched dark crack network, narrow jagged fissures with small secondary forks, stretched diagonal, no rock slab or background.
Bottom right: a distinctly different ceiling seepage stain with three broad uneven dark moisture tracks and numerous slender water streaks descending at unequal lengths, subtle faded brown mineral traces, translucent thinning ends.
Style: believable tactile semi-realistic fantasy game texture, subdued aged dungeon palette. Texture detail should read at a distance through coherent shapes, not busy noise. Flat diffuse color only, no baked lighting or perspective.
Composition: strict equal 512x512 cell layout. Every decal remains within its own cell with at least 32px completely transparent padding on all four cell edges. Nothing bleeds into another cell. Irregular transparent edges, no rectangular color patches.
Avoid: any solid wall background, stone texture surrounding cracks, tiles or brick pattern, water droplets, leaves, vines, large plants, bright green, bright white lines, lighting, cast shadows, labels, borders, checkerboard painted into the image, symbols or text. Actual transparency required.
